desc: The roots of the Browning BAR run deep, tracing its history back to John M. Browning's original design for the U.S. military during the First World War. These legendary firearms earned an amazing service record, being used even into the early days of the Vietnam War. Timeless in appearance yet modern in functionality. The BAR MK 4 Hunter Composite is the hunting rifle that establishes the standard for all other autoloaders worldwide, offering precision, speed, and a selection of calibers – including magnums – that no other hunting autoloader can rival. With the composite stock, this rifle withstands every hunting condition. It features shim adjustments for cast on and off, as well as for drop at comb. Regarding the comb, the SoftFlex cheekpad is elevated, ensuring that the shooter's eye is properly aligned with their optic. Additionally, the rubber overmolding on the gripping surfaces improves security in all conditions.
